posts.text: Lavrov backs Tehran, but does Russia also gain from the US-Iran crisis? — Moscow pledges support to its sanctioned ally, but analysts say the war Iran wants to end has filled Russia’s coffers.
Pakistan army chief in Tehran: Can diplomacy prevent new US-Iran fighting? — With new talk of escalation, Islamabad is trying to revive negotiations without alienating Tehran, Riyadh or Washington.

Yemeni City of Taiz Running Out of Essentials as Houthis Close in — The Iranian-backed Houthi militia has cut road access to Taiz, one of Yemen’s largest cities, besieging it. Officials there warn of an impending humanitarian disaster.
Why Does Saudi Arabia Struggle to Stop Houthi Attacks? — The Saudi military has expensive equipment, but the missiles and drones used by the Yemeni militia are difficult to detect and stop.
US envoy Barrack defends decision to join Israel in war on Iran — US envoy Tom Barrack says President Trump did not follow Israel in going to war against Iran.

UK to Send Fighter Jets to Help Defend Saudi Arabia From Houthi Attacks — R.A.F. Typhoon fighter jets will be deployed to protect infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, Britain said, after a spike in attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi militia.

Trump’s Turn Toward Moscow. Plus. . . — In today's Front Page: Aaron MacLean on Trump's turn toward Moscow. A report from the aftermath of the French riots. The scientist who won his life back. Arthur Brooks interviews his AI clone. And more.
Iran, Taunting Trump Over Gas Prices, Braces for Aftermath of Midterm Elections — The midterm elections appear to be a factor for both sides in the war as President Trump weighs his next steps.

Saudi Arabia Delays Flagship Investment Summit to 2027 After Houthi Attacks — Saudi Arabia moves its flagship FII investment summit to 2027 as Houthi attacks disrupt travel and put the kingdom’s investment ambitions under scrutiny. Riyadh’s airport limits traffic following the attacks, adding to the challenges facing the gathering. Asian shares decline despite a recovery in US technology stocks. Renewed buying in chipmakers lifts the Nasdaq after the recent selloff and reduces demand for Treasuries as a haven. Oil fluctuates near a five-month peak, with Brent around $110 as Middle East risks and uncertainty over diesel supplies persist. Natixis Emerging Asia Senior Econ

Houthi Strikes Kill Dozens in Yemeni Desert Military Camp, Officials Say — The Iranian-backed militia struck with ballistic missiles deep in government-held central Yemen, in what appeared to be among the deadliest attacks of the renewed war.

Iran regime under pressure as rebel groups escalate attacks in volatile southeast — A coalition of armed rebel groups is stepping up attacks against Iranian regime forces in the country's volatile southeast, raising questions about Tehran's grip on the region.

Trump announces $8B bailout for farmers to cover diesel cost surge amid attacks on global supply — President Donald Trump announced the $8 billion Harvest Fuel Relief program at a Kansas rally to offset rising diesel costs for farmers during harvest season.

Is Trump Getting Ready to Trade Ukraine for Iran? — As the president eases pressure on Russia, he is moving toward a foreign policy with no major postwar precedent: pursuing America’s interests at the expense of its allies, writes Aaron MacLean.

JD Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu despite Trump's strong backing — Vice President JD Vance said he will not weigh in on Israel's upcoming election after Trump threw his support behind Netanyahu's reelection bid.

Saudi Arabia Postpones Its FII Investment Event After Houthi Attacks — The Future Investment Initiative, a centerpiece of Saudi efforts to diversify its economy from its reliance on the energy industry, was set to begin next week.

Beleaguered Macron cites US-Iran war as factor in protests amid Trump, Vance criticism — French President Emmanuel Macron cited the Iran war and its impact on fuel and living costs while addressing the ongoing protests and unrest across France.
Can Ukraine Win Without America? — Retired Australian major general Mick Ryan explains why Russia is struggling on the battlefield and why Trump may be Putin’s best hope.
